title: Resolution urging Albany to fund counseling for traumatized jurors
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation creating a program offering up to ten hours of free post-trial psychological counseling to jurors who served in cases involving graphic or highly emotional evidence. It cites research showing nearly half of jurors in violent criminal cases experience trauma-related symptoms, and notes Texas already allows counties to run similar programs. New York currently provides no such mandated mental health support for jurors.
